selection: Every observed offered Skill action in all 78 frozen source trajectories, independent of outcome; supported families only; read-only replay prefix and at least one remaining continuation decision. All exclusions are recorded.
intervention: At an exactly reproduced context, full SQLite dump and remaining fault queues, force either the recorded Skill or the corresponding primitive mutation. Keep the Gate, Skill candidates, policy, total 16-step budget and pinned HTTP model unchanged. The real model selects every subsequent action.
scope: Retrospective within-simulator action intervention conditional on observed eligible Skill-use contexts. One deterministic continuation per arm; not population-wide NTR, not unseen-test generalization, not a training or deployment selection experiment. Original whole-system NTR fields remain unchanged.
